A1.justification: Both PDFs describe Calgacus. v5 is an Italian translation with matching main sections, Appendix A.1–A.5, and Figures 1–15. The text, equations and visual material support a reliable comparison.

before.justification: v4 reports original Reddit-text evaluations, token-rank analyses, model comparisons with encoding/decoding timings, and qualitative demonstrations in the appendices.

after.justification: v5 retains these original empirical results. Its Figure 1 translation note identifies the Italian example texts as translations of the English originals.

M1.justification: The token-rank encoding and inverse reconstruction procedures are unchanged. Optional conditioning prompts, using different models, vocabulary-size handling and rank inversion were already described in v4, including its appendix.

E1.justification: The Reddit and Economist analyses, domain examples and chatbot demonstration are retained. Translated examples do not establish Italian-language evaluation. INVALSI and MMLU-5s appear as cited context in v5, rather than datasets newly evaluated by this work.

E2.justification: Figure 8 retains Llama3-8B, Gemma3-27B, Qwen3-8B, Phi4-14B, Phi3-3.8B and GPT2-163M. Figure 4 retains the random-ASCII and random-English-word controls. The new reference to Llama3-70B does not add it to the Calgacus comparisons.

E3.justification: Both versions use 1,000 Reddit texts truncated to 85 tokens, select three originals at the mean and approximately two standard deviations either side, and generate 100 stegotexts per original. Scoring models, model configurations and timing conditions are retained.

E4.justification: The analyses of domain dependence, model quality, token ranks, rank inversion and prompt steering remain. The random-key, chatbot and deniability examples also match across translation. Figure 10's relocation adds no analysis.

E5.justification: Figure 10 retains the median, 25th–75th percentile boxes and 20th/80th percentile whiskers, with the same explanation about heavy tails. No repeated-run information, confidence intervals or significance-testing procedures are added.

E6.justification: v5 newly quotes external INVALSI scores of 75.6% for Llama3-70B versus 47.9% for 8B, attributed to Mercorio et al. (2024). The work's own quantitative plots, Figure 8 timings and Figure 15 log-probabilities remain unchanged; these are not new Calgacus results.

T1.justification: The text-probability definition, key-search complexity bound and Appendix A.4 vocabulary-mapping calculations and arithmetic-coding discussion are retained. No theorem, proof or substantive mathematical revision is introduced.

C1.justification: The translated abstract, introduction and conclusions retain the claims of equal-token-length concealment, steerability, efficient operation with small models, and implications for alignment, knowledge, hallucination and authorial intent.

C2.justification: The new Figure 1 note adds an Italian-specific applicability qualification: satisfactory operation depends on Italian fluency, typically associated with larger models such as Llama3-70B. v4 discusses general model and domain dependence without this language-specific qualification.

D1.justification: Hardware, quantization, llama.cpp/Python and companion-notebook disclosures are retained. v5 makes the default k' = 'A text:' prominent in Section 3, but v4 already identifies it in Figures 10 and 15; this is clarification of existing information.

R1.justification: v5 adds Mercorio et al. (2024) to support its discussion of Italian model proficiency. The positioning relative to existing steganography methods remains unchanged. The Tacitus quotation uses an Italian translation source instead of the English edition.

P1.justification: The title, main narrative, appendix prose, captions and most example texts are comprehensively translated into Italian. Terminology and phrasing are extensively rewritten, although the section hierarchy and argument sequence remain substantially intact.

P2.justification: All 15 figures remain. Figure 1 reorders its stegotext examples, Figure 2 uses an Italian comic excerpt with an additional panel, and Figure 3 is localized. The method box spans two pages and Figure 10 moves to a separate page. Quantitative plot images are unchanged.

improvement.justification: v5 principally localizes the same scientific paper into Italian while retaining its method, original measurements and appendix evidence. The added language-proficiency context and clearer placement of the default prompt are limited refinements. They leave the overall evidential support and substantive limitations essentially unchanged.
